cards.text: Brand new book, baker! These are the words of Jeremiah son of Hilkiah, one of the priests in Anathoth, in the territory of Benjamin. Grab an apron, because this man is about to get a job he did NOT see coming.
The word of the LORD first comes to Jeremiah in the thirteenth year of Josiah son of Amon, king of Judah.

cards.question: Once King Josiah's reign is over, the word of the LORD stops coming to Jeremiah.

cards.text: It keeps coming through the days of King Jehoiakim, Josiah's son, all the way to the fifth month of the eleventh year of King Zedekiah, another son of Josiah. That's not a job, friend. That's a CAREER. Longest I ever stayed anywhere was a junk drawer, and nobody called me once.

cards.question: Jeremiah's messages from the LORD run until Zedekiah's eleventh year. What happens to the people of Jerusalem then?

cards.text: Now Jeremiah tells it himself: "The word of the LORD came to me, saying:" And the LORD doesn't open with Jeremiah's résumé, friend. He goes WAY back before it.

cards.question: The LORD tells Jeremiah that before he was ___, the LORD set him apart.
The LORD says He appointed Jeremiah as a prophet before he was born. A prophet to whom?

cards.text: Jeremiah answers right away, and it starts with "Ah, Lord GOD," which is never how a yes starts. I'm not judging, friend. When an angel showed up at my junk drawer, I asked him if he had the right drawer.

cards.question: What reason does Jeremiah give the LORD after He calls him to be a prophet?

answers.text: He's only a child and can't speak
He's too busy with his priest work
The people will never listen to him

cards.text: The LORD tells him, "Do not say, 'I am only a child.'" That excuse lasted about as long as a warm cookie on the cooling rack.

cards.question: The LORD tells Jeremiah he can pick which of the LORD's commands he wants to speak.
The LORD tells Jeremiah not to be afraid of the people, because He is with him to ___ him.

cards.text: Then the LORD reaches out His hand and touches Jeremiah's mouth. Yes, friend. THAT mouth. The one that just said it doesn't know how to speak.

cards.question: When the LORD touches Jeremiah's mouth, what does He say He has put there?

cards.text: Then the LORD says He has appointed Jeremiah today over nations and kingdoms, with a job list that starts with uprooting and tearing down. Day one, friend. No training video. No orientation. Just GO.

cards.question: The job the LORD gives Jeremiah over nations and kingdoms is only about tearing things down.

cards.text: Then the word of the LORD comes again with a pop quiz: "Jeremiah, what do you see?" Jeremiah says he sees a branch of an almond tree, and if that were me, I'd be sweating right through my apron.

cards.question: The LORD tells Jeremiah he has observed the almond branch correctly. What does the LORD say He is watching over?

cards.text: Again the word of the LORD comes: "What do you see?" This time Jeremiah sees a boiling pot, and it's TILTING.

cards.question: Jeremiah sees the boiling pot tilting toward them from the ___.
The LORD explains the tilting boiling pot. What will be poured out on all who live in the land?

cards.text: The LORD declares He is about to summon all the clans and kingdoms of the north. Their kings are coming, and friend, they are NOT coming for cookies.

cards.question: The kings from the north will set up their thrones at the entrance of Jerusalem's ___.
The kings from the north will attack Jerusalem's walls but leave the other cities of Judah alone.

cards.text: Then the LORD says He will pronounce His judgments against them for all their wickedness. And He spells out exactly why.

cards.question: Why does the LORD say He will pronounce His judgments against His people?

answers.text: They forsook Him and worshiped other gods
They made a treaty with Egypt instead
They let the temple fall into ruins

cards.text: Then the LORD tells Jeremiah, "Get yourself ready. Stand up and tell them everything that I command you." No snooze button on this alarm, friend.

cards.question: The LORD tells Jeremiah not to be ___ by the people, or He will terrify him before them.

cards.text: Then the LORD says that this day He has made Jeremiah "like a fortified city, an iron pillar, and bronze walls". From only a child to LIKE an iron pillar in one conversation. Friend, that is a GLOW-UP.

cards.question: The LORD makes Jeremiah like a fortified city with bronze walls. Against whom?

answers.text: The whole land and its leaders
Only the armies from the north

cards.question: The LORD ends by promising Jeremiah that no one will ever fight against him.

cards.text: Here's the real promise: "They will fight against you but will never overcome you, since I am with you to deliver you." And there's that line again, friend: I am with you to deliver you.

findings.problem: Stop 2, card 16 quotes "They will fight against you but will never overcome you, since I am with you to deliver you.", which isn't the exact BSB wording.

rule.text: Quotes: Quotation marks around Bible words mean the exact BSB wording, punctuation included.

findings.problem: "This man is about to get a job he did NOT see coming" states Jeremiah's expectation as a fact. The text never says whether Jeremiah expected the call.

rule.text: Feelings: He can guess at a feeling, marked as his own ("I think," "I bet"). Never as fact.
Every other story card is 1 to 2 sentences.

findings.problem: "Longest I ever stayed anywhere was a junk drawer, and nobody called me once" adds to his backstory. The backstory never says the drawer was his longest stay, and the angel did call him out of the drawer ("I've been called out of the drawer"), so the line contradicts it.

rule.text: His own world isn't Bible fact. His backstory, family, bakery and mission are the Dorinverse story in this file. He can talk about them freely, but never adds anything new to them.

findings.problem: The card cites only Jeremiah 1:4, but "He goes WAY back before it" tells the content of 1:5 (before the womb, before birth). The citation should be Jeremiah 1:4-5.

rule.text: Cite exactly what the card uses. Every story card cites the verses it tells, from the first verse it uses to the last, no wider and no narrower.
Every other story card is 1 to 2 sentences.

findings.problem: The wrong answer "grown" can be argued as right. If the LORD set Jeremiah apart before he was born, He also set him apart before he was grown. The setup on card 6 ("WAY back before" his résumé) fits "grown" too.

rule.text: No near-matches. A wrong answer never means the same as the right answer, or close to it. If a baker could argue it's right, replace it.

findings.problem: "Jeremiah answers right away" adds a time the text doesn't give. Jeremiah 1:6 says only "I said."

rule.text: Times stay true. No time in the text means none added.
Every other story card is 1 to 2 sentences.

findings.problem: The right answer "He's only a child and can't speak" changes the text's meaning. Jeremiah says he does "not know how to speak" (1:6). "Can't speak" suggests he is unable to talk, which the text shows is untrue, since he is speaking.

rule.text: Retelling: Papa Dorin can retell in his own words and fill in what the text clearly implies. Scene-setting details are fine. He never says anything the text shows is wrong.

findings.problem: The story card has 4 sentences ("Then the LORD reaches out..." / "Yes, friend." / "THAT mouth." / "The one that just said...").

rule.text: Every other story card is 1 to 2 sentences.
Every other story card is 1 to 2 sentences.

findings.problem: "Pop quiz" is a school reference used as a joke.

rule.text: No jokes or scenarios about school, parents or anything aimed at kids. Work, bosses and bills are fine.
Every other story card is 1 to 2 sentences.

findings.problem: Both wrong answers start with "Only" and the right answer doesn't, so the right answer stands out by its pattern.

rule.text: Don't let the right answer stand out. All the answers should sound alike.
